regression_fixtures.contract: Six actual-provider cases for deferred connection/index results, errors, loading completion and unmount; all original nine Web scenarios preserved.
Eight lost-reply/deadline, reconnect, late-result, failure-recovery and retirement cases; all prior fifteen scenarios preserved.

Actual SDK global mutex and Web Streams verify that a UI deadline does not cancel a pending read, repeated Refresh queues no work, and stream replacement recovers. Physical transport remains outside this fixture.

preserved_assertions: Relocated fixtures retain their prior assertions; no snapshot auto-accept or unique assertion removal.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.
Host DT accessors are controlled while Zephyr macro utilities and nanopb are real. Owner native/board builds separately validate real DT binding/API compatibility.
native_verification: tests/native_verifier.py: actual exit, registered test completion, raw ordered logs, unchanged snapshots, identical binary repeated three times.

review_regressions.contract: Grouped/root device families preserve geometry, links, flags and bounds; the peripheral cannot enable the handler without core RPC. Original assertions and all three board targets retained.
review_regressions.repeats: Each optimized/sanitized protocol binary and native fixture executes three times.
review_regressions.negative_control: nested devices omitted coherently restores root-only trackball link-function generation and matching device enumeration; both selectors match exactly once. Other four faults, five-case order, compiler flags and runtime assertions remain unchanged; compilation failure never counts as detection.

protocol_evidence.contract: No arguments preserve quick/full case order, compiler argv/flags, fixture assertions, same-binary three repetitions and final oversized-name compile-refusal. Focused selection explicitly records canonical full matrix NOT RUN.
protocol_evidence.retention: Explicit output preserves inputs/hashes, generated artifacts, actual binaries/hashes, commands, ordered process logs, selected environment/complete environment hash and partial results even on fail-fast errors; source drift fails admission. The negative dispatcher supplies a fresh output for each unchanged baseline/fault invocation.
protocol_evidence.limits: No execution is implied by runner setup. Evidence includes local paths and requires a reviewed publication copy; focused results do not replace the complete owner matrix.
